results.boundary: Main-thread CADisplayLink callback cadence, NOT GPU presentation FPS or verified rendered frames
results.clockMapping: Per-session epochMs = (wallTimeEpochSeconds + record.uptimeSeconds - session.uptimeSeconds) * 1000; no cross-clock sleep assumptions

missedCadenceEstimate.note: Estimate only; null/reset/unstable cadence records excluded. Not a GPU dropped-frame count.

rss.method: Host mach task_info, sampled by background timer at nominal 1Hz; transient peaks may be missed
rss.note: Cumulative peak may precede action window. When main thread is blocked, intermediate 1Hz samples have no individual rows; their peak survives only in cumulative peak. Do not label cumulative peak as exact window peak.

limitations: Callback gaps above 50ms indicate scheduling gaps, not direct proof of CPU long tasks
An abrupt process exit without capture-limit or loss marker cannot be detected reliably from JSONL alone
Per-session wall/uptime mapping assumes wall clock is not adjusted within that capture; restart capture after sleep/clock changes when precise action alignment matters
